peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 50.5% above its local comparables; 36 of 36 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (97.3): 4.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 53 of 55 similar developments with a figure (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 3-bedroom: median $2,312,500 ($2,020 psf, 1,130–1,173 sq ft; 6 resales, Apr 2025–Mar 2026); 8 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,342 psf (range $1,118–1,925); 50.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $776,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: King Albert Park MRT about 390 m, Beauty World MRT about 570 m; closer than 16 of 63 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Pei Hwa Presbyterian Primary School about 490 m; more than 37 of 63 similar developments (the same as 17). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 230 m), more than 28 of 63 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Bukit Timah Market about 480 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 80 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Upcoming on the Cross Island Line: Maju MRT about 950 m (LTA target 2032) and Turf City MRT about 1,420 m (LTA target 2032), both under construction. Straight-line distances to the planned station sites; entrances are not yet published.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Reserve Residences, 2 new sales, about 400 m; 8@BT, 34 new sales, about 550 m; Amberwood at Holland, 24 new sales, about 1,360 m; Dunearn House, 237 new sales, about 1,530 m; The Sen, 177 new sales, about 1,720 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 74 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 474 new sales and 354 resales (828 purchases); new sales were 57.2% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Holland Plain GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,310 m; Dunearn Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,400 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 354 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 22 of 63 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 354 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 371 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.6%). Planning-area private resales −4.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
